title: Samurai vs Orca Underwater
description: A dynamic underwater scene depicts a cybernetic samurai rabbit with glowing blue ears and katana leaping toward a large orca whale. To the left, a female warrior in white and purple dashes forward while a red-armored figure leaps from the right, all surrounded by bubbles and debris in a flooded cyberpunk city street.
